${mod_id}.modmenu.group.visual.name: Visual
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.particles_trans: Controls transparency of all particles on the screen.
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.family_generatio:
Controls which mods and items automatic family particle generation will work for. Family particles are generated for modded items based on their rendered look. An item must pass both the mods filter and the items filter. 

!!!!! NOTE: after changing these lists you must regenerate particles — delete the old cache with the "Invalidate Cache Now" button below, then reload resources with F3 + T.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.family_generati: How the mods list is applied. Blacklist — family particles are generated for all mods except those in the list; Whitelist — family particles are generated only for mods in the list.
Mod ids (namespaces) to filter, separated by spaces. E.g. "minecraft create farmersdelight". Leave empty for no filtering (with Blacklist mode).
How the items list is applied. Blacklist — family particles are generated for all items except those in the list; Whitelist — family particles are generated only for items in the list.
Item ids to filter, separated by spaces. E.g. "minecraft:diamond create:wrench". You can copy an id from the item's tooltip (with F3 + H enabled). Leave empty for no filtering (with Blacklist mode).
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.cache.name: Modded Items Cache
${mod_id}.modmenu.group.cache.descriptio: Settings controlling cached assets used for modded items.
${mod_id}.modmenu.option.invalidate_mode: When cached assets for modded items should be deleted to be recreated.
Immediately invalidates cached assets for modded items.
${mod_id}.particles_linking.title: Linking Particles To Items
${mod_id}.notice_message:
§a[${mod_name}]§e Hello %s§e! Thanks your for installing Item Particles! §r

§rJust want to let you know, that mod has native support for items from other mods!

How it works: The mod takes items and creates particle textures for them based on it's own *patterns*. This can take some time depending on the number of modded items in the game §e(right now there %s§e!).§r

To see the progress, open your inventory and hover in the upper-right corner.

Usually it doesn't affect FPS, but in rare cases you may experience a slight frame drop during the generation. This is normal and will only happen once!

Once complete, everything will be cached/saved and load very quickly.

To clear the cache or change its behaviour, open the mod's settings menu.

§eThank you for your attention! This message will not appear again.
Enjoy!
